tasks.title: Fix relay missing thread_database_id and post-github idempotency
tasks.description:
Root cause: relay SKILL.md step 4 pass list omits `thread_database_id`, so post-github never receives it. Without it, the idempotency jq filter (`select(.in_reply_to_id == ${thread_database_id}`) silently errors via `2>/dev/null || echo 0`, always returns 0, and never blocks a duplicate post. Haiku then posts, and if it perceives response ambiguity it violates the no-retry rule and posts again.

Failing scenario: relay delegates 4 parallel reply tasks → post-github agents each receive no thread_database_id → idempotency check always passes → 3 of 4 threads get duplicate comments.

Test seam: no automated test seam exists for GitHub API comment creation. The idempotency bash logic can be unit-tested by mocking `gh api` responses. Write a minimal bash test at `~/.dotfiles/claude-code-shared/tests/test-post-github-idempotency.sh` that stubs `gh api` to simulate (a) zero existing replies → expect one POST, (b) one existing reply → expect zero POSTs.

Fix approach:
1. In `~/.dotfiles/claude-code-shared/skills/relay/SKILL.md` step 4 pass list, add `thread_database_id` after `thread_id_type`.
2. In `~/.dotfiles/claude-code-shared/agents/egress/github/post-github.md`:
   a. Add input field doc for `thread_database_id` and a fallback: if not provided, parse from target URL anchor (`#discussion_r<N>` → N).
   b. After step 4 POST call, add explicit: 'After the first POST returns, exit immediately. Do not make a second POST call for any reason, including ambiguous response or missing html_url.'
   c. On non-zero exit_code, return status: failed and exit 1 immediately. Do not re-run the POST.

Files: `~/.dotfiles/claude-code-shared/skills/relay/SKILL.md`, `~/.dotfiles/claude-code-shared/agents/egress/github/post-github.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Bash test at ~/.dotfiles/claude-code-shared/tests/test-post-github-idempotency.sh exists and passes: stub gh api to return 1 existing reply → post-github exits without posting
relay SKILL.md step 4 pass list includes thread_database_id
post-github.md documents thread_database_id input and adds URL-anchor fallback parse
post-github.md step 4 exit path says: after first POST returns, exit immediately regardless of outcome
Running relay on a PR with graphql_node_id threads produces exactly one comment per thread (no duplicates)
tasks.summary: Added thread_database_id to relay SKILL.md step 4 pass list. post-github.md gains URL-anchor fallback parse, exit-immediately no-retry rule, and exit 1 on failure. Bash idempotency test added (4/4 pass).
